title: Accounting Note with Worked Dates — Holding-Period Fraction in Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Reversals, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
In reversing a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock dividend, the holding-period fraction charges the cancelled shares only for the part of the quarter they stood on the holding. The dividend's quarter runs from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026, 91 days.

## Rule

- When the cancellation is dated inside the dividend's quarter, the fraction is the days from the cancellation date to the quarter's last day, both counted, divided by the days in the quarter.
- When it is dated after the quarter's end, the fraction is zero: the cancelled shares earned nothing in that quarter.
- Otherwise the fraction is one: the whole quarter.

The reversal on the holding is multiplied by the fraction, which is not rounded.

## Terms used

- **The cancellation**: the holding's latest subscription-cancelled entry, read by its effective date.
- **Inside the dividend's quarter**: dated on or after 1 April 2026 and on or before 30 June 2026.
- **Days in the quarter**: 91.

## Worked dates

| Cancellation dated | Days counted (cancellation date to 30 June 2026, both counted) | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 20 May 2026 | 42 | 42 over 91, 0.4615… |
| 1 April 2026 | 91 | 1 |
| 30 June 2026 | 1 | 1 over 91 |
| 3 July 2026 | — after the quarter's end | 0 |
| 15 March 2026 | — before the quarter | 1 |
